reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown read Numbers 33's drive-out command as itself meaning extermination per Deuteronomy 7, collapsing dispossession and annihilation into one program.

discrepancy.note: Ingersoll quotes the herem command itself as proof Jehovah ordered no mercy, no covenant, and total destruction of the Canaanites.

quotes.text: Jehovah ordered a Jewish general to make war, and gave, among others, this command: "When the Lord thy God shall drive them before thee, thou shalt smite them and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor show mercy unto them."
quotes.attr: Robert G. Ingersoll (d. 1899), The Christian Religion, pt. III (1881), on Deuteronomy 7:2.

sides.snippet: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
sides.verseText: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

sides.snippet: you shall utterly destroy them: you shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them;
sides.verseText: and when Yahweh your God shall deliver them up before you, and you shall strike them; then you shall utterly destroy them: you shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them;
